definitions.explanation: A period of time granted before something must be done or before a decision takes effect. Often used in legal and official contexts for extensions, deferrals, or probation.

examples.japanese: {猶予|ゆうよ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no more time to spare.

examples.japanese: {支払|しはら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{猶予|ゆうよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}めて→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I was granted a grace period for payment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{懲役|ちょうえき}→懲役：11087_choueki⟧3⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧、⟦{執行|しっこう}→執行：18996_shikkou⟧{猶予|ゆうよ}5⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{言|い}い{渡|わた}された→言い渡す：07002_iiwatasu⟧。
examples.english: A sentence of three years imprisonment, suspended for five years, was handed down.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as a noun and suru-verb. In legal contexts, ⟦{執行|しっこう}→執行：18996_shikkou⟧{猶予|ゆうよ} means a suspended sentence — the prison term is deferred on condition of good behavior. In everyday language, {猶予|ゆうよ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ means there is no time to waste or no room for delay.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{執行|しっこう}→執行：18996_shikkou⟧{猶予|ゆうよ}: suspended sentence
- {猶予|ゆうよ}{期間|きかん}: grace period
- {猶予|ゆうよ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no time to spare
- {猶予|ゆうよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to grant a reprieve
- {支払|しはら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{猶予|ゆうよ}: payment deferral
